title: Financial Assistance Program (Charity Care) — Award Term, Look-Back and Renewal Settings
content:
## Award term settings by tier

| Tier | Months after the determination date that the award covers new services | Retroactive look-back before the application date | Renewal window before the award end date | Approved awards held at once |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Riverbend Presumptive Charity Care | 6 | 365 days | 30 days | 1 |
| Riverbend Full Charity Care (0-200% FPL) | 6 | 365 days | 30 days | 1 |
| Riverbend 80% Charity Discount (201-250% FPL) | 6 | 365 days | 30 days | 1 |
| Riverbend 60% Charity Discount (251-300% FPL) | 6 | 365 days | 30 days | 1 |
| Riverbend 40% Charity Discount (301-400% FPL) | 6 | 365 days | 30 days | 1 |
| Riverbend Medical Hardship Assistance (above 400% FPL) | 12 | 365 days | 30 days | 1 |

The retroactive look-back is the integer calendar days before the application date whose services with open balances the award also covers. The renewal window is the integer calendar days before the award end date within which a renewal application may be filed to start the next award the day after the current one ends.

## Revocation grounds (every tier)

An approved award of the Financial Assistance Program (Charity Care) is revoked only on these grounds: falsified information; an undisclosed third-party liability payment.

### Note

The Medical Hardship tier covers new services for 12 months after the determination date; every other tier covers 6 months.
